easy.def: A friendly word for a boy or man.
examples: My cousin is a cool dude.

more.def: A casual word for a man or boy, often used to talk to a friend.
examples: That dude on the skateboard is really good.
Some people call their friends dude.

easy.def: At some time while something goes on.
examples: Do not talk during the movie.

more.def: Throughout the time that something goes on, or at some point in it.
examples: The bears sleep during the winter.
It rained several times during the night.
Please stay quiet during the show.
It is my duty to feed the fish.
Her duty is to hand out papers.
Setting the table is my duty.

more.def: Something that you must do because it is your job or the right thing to do.
examples: It is a lifeguard's duty to watch the swimmers.
Feeding the dog is my duty each morning.
Voting is a duty of every adult citizen.
